statement.p: A town has 3700 registered residents. Among them, there are 1443 Democrats and 851 Republicans. The rest are Independents. What percentage of registered voters in this town are Independents?
In this town, of all registered voters are Independents.

solution.p: Out of 3700 registered voters, there are 1443 Democrats and 851 Republicans. This implies there are 3700-1443-851=1406 Independents.
Now this problem can be boiled down to this question: 1406 is what percent of 3700? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem.
Assume 1406 is x\% of 3700, so x out of 100 corresponds to 1406 out of 3700.
We will write and solve the proportion:
In this town, 38\% of all registered voters are Independents.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem.
This translation from English to may should help you remember the percentage formula.
Assume 1406 is x (as a percent) of 3700. We have:
In this town, 38\% of all registered voters are Independents.
In the sentence 1406 is what percent of 3700,

li.p: 3700 is the base (following the word of).

solution.p: By the formula \text{rate} = \frac{\text{percentage}}{\text{base}}, we do a division to solve the problem:
In this town, 38\% of all registered voters are Independents.
